name: Private Messages
project_description: Privatemsg allows your site's visitors to send private messages to each other. Perfect for community oriented sites, such as forums and social networking sites. In 2.x the data model is rebuilt on two custom content entities (privatemsg_message and privatemsg_thread): a conversation is a 'group' of per-recipient thread rows, each owned by one participant, all pointing at the same shared message entities. Features include a Views-based inbox with VBO bulk actions (mark read/unread, remove, change tags), a per-user unread-counter block and account-menu badge, recipient autocomplete (users or whole roles), per-user block lists with unblockable roles, personal thread tags (taxonomy), optional email notification on new messages, and cron-based purging of soft-deleted messages. Includes migration submodules from Drupal 6 and 7 and a drush command to migrate from privatemsg 1.x.
